subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and refresh https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this Control UI resolver fix, or close it and request a fresh current-main PR?
rationale: The source-level issue remains valid, but an open linked fork PR already contains the focused resolver/test change and blocks duplicate automated repair; its stale check state and older UI path require human handling.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile the moved UI path, and resolve stale check state.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Set the fork PR aside and ask for a current-main UI-only resolver PR with focused proof and regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile the moved UI path, and resolve stale check state.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the channel UI metadata and catalog path introduced in prior work.
